name: csharp-best-practices
description: C# 14 best practices skill plugin with dotnet CLI agent.

Write integration tests for this API using Verify snapshots
Build and run the tests for this .NET solution
capabilities: Write and review C# code with modern C# 14 idioms
Run dotnet CLI builds, tests, and publishes with structured output
Design MongoDB, API, and Playwright E2E tests with Testcontainers and Verify
